headline: Midnight Flurry Hits Mooring as Palantine Cools
war_summary: Since the evening edition the wire has cooled in several lively sectors while fresh stirrings mark the midnight hour. Palantine Berm, lately lively, eases to three changes in two hours and forty-five on the day, holding seven Warden posts around Leiri Hermanni, last heard at 22:44, with day losses of 793 Colonial and 741 Warden. The Weathered Expanse and Mooring County both report three changes in the last two hours and were last heard at the midnight cutoff, the former standing three Warden, five Colonial and one unheld about Crow's Nest and Wightwalk with 4,335 Colonial and 7,506 Warden losses on the day, the latter holding twelve Warden posts about the Wind Hills with 6,263 Colonial and 5,880 Warden losses. The Nevish Line, still the busiest day sector with fifty changes, records none in the last two hours and stands six Warden, one Colonial and one unheld, last heard at 21:16. Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf show no changes in two hours, though both carry heavy day casualties, while Callahan's Passage falls silent after twenty-three day changes.
